description:
`scripts/cleanup.sh` removes build folders under `builds/` older than N days. We want it on a nightly cron on ci-runner-2 (see PLAT-198), but nobody wants to point it at a runner blind.

Add a `--dry-run` flag that prints what it would delete and deletes nothing. Without the flag it should behave exactly as it does today.

comments.author: marcus.webb@northwind.dev
comments.body: +1. I'd like to run it with --dry-run on ci-runner-2 before the cron goes in.
